fields.reasoning: The question asks which intent and what shape. Intent: m4-runs-hold-up says a run finishes without hand repair; here the orchestrator had to move a stray .github/workflows/rhiza.yml off main by hand, and the previous run-repair bug fix (#484) served the same intent, so it is the clear fit. Shape: the cause is run.TmpDir (internal/run/store.go:45) placing run tmp at <git common dir>/rhiza/runs/<id>/tmp and ship-change/bugfix/plan-bug/docs workflows setting GOTMPDIR={run_tmp}; go-internal testscript makes $WORK under GOTMPDIR, so scripts that run git/rhiza without their own repo resolve to ~/code/rhiza. Moving run tmp out of the repo fixes every workflow and any other tool that uses {run_tmp} at once without editing the .rhiza/workflows files, unlike per-workflow overrides. The Setup guard is the change set's second fix idea and is cheap defense in depth: it catches any other way $WORK lands in a repo (a hand-set GOTMPDIR, a future workflow), turning a silent write to main into a clear test failure. Both ideas come from the change set's own intent text; I kept the run tmp lifecycle (made at step start, removed at run end) unchanged so nothing else in the engine moves.
fields.statement: Change set 01M77VT6 serves m4-runs-hold-up. Fix it at the source and guard the tests: (1) a run's {run_tmp} moves outside every git repository, to a per-user cache dir (os.UserCacheDir()/rhiza/run-tmp/<run id>, falling back to os.TempDir()/rhiza-run-tmp-<uid>/<run id>), still made as a step starts and removed when the run ends, so GOTMPDIR and anything else a workflow points at {run_tmp} no longer sit under <git common dir>; run.TmpDir/Store.TmpDir and the {run_tmp} docs change accordingly and existing workflows need no edit. (2) cmd/rhiza's testscript Setup fails a script whose $WORK resolves inside a git work tree or git dir (git rev-parse from $WORK before the script runs), naming the path and saying to set GOTMPDIR outside the repo, so no script can reach a real repo again. A testscript or unit test covers each: {run_tmp} resolves outside the repo's common dir, and Setup refuses a $WORK under a git repo.
